Lumicam 4000B Series Imaging Photometer and Colormeter 
 INSTRUMENT SYSTEM LUMICAM 4000B SERIES
Speaker: Dr. Cameron Hughes
Duration :  2 minutes 
The Next Generation Filter-Based Luminance & Color Imaging Photometer With Maximum User-Friendliness
LumiCam 4000B a new vis a vis the predecessor model:
motorized objective lenses
12MP camera for high resolution images
approximately 20% smaller footprint for compact design.
LumiCam 4000B generation is the ideal instrument for easy and reliable measurement of displays and control elements, e.g. for the automotive interior or aviation industries. It is equally suitable for test in the laboratory and quality assurance. The new LumiCam 4000B come in 3 variants.
Mono – for luminance measurement only
Color – for luminance measurement and chromaticity analysis with 4 filter-based that is particularly suitable for broadband light sources.
Advanced – for luminance measurement and 6 filtered-based that supported chromaticity analysis for optimal measurements of LED based test objects.
Lumicam 4000B even offers a 12 Megapixels resolution. Lumicam 400B camera sensors permits spatially resolved 2D acquisition of all colorimetric and photometric data. This new lenses with motorized apertures and focus make for sample operation and are available in various different focal length
Extended features with the proven LumiCam software
New features include polyline analysis and live reticle, enabling exact measurement of even complex display elements.
Various analysis features such as spot meter, polygons, and flexible polylines
Straightforward determination of luminance distributions, color coordinates / Black Mura, dot or line defects, or contrast
APPLICATIONS
Automotive Exterior & Interior Lighting | Car Infotainment Display | LED LCD TV Display Characterization | Smart Phone | Tablet PC | LED / Modules etc.
